mostWorthwhile.text: Clearing the bay was most worthwhile: the drum, hopper and spoil pile showed how the assembled machine actually did its work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the power cable was the least interesting step because the unplugged lead made the choice explicit, though it was sensible preparation.

surprise.text: The cleared cave provides shelter but no breathable air, a useful reminder that excavation alone does not make it habitable.

arbitrary.text: None felt particularly arbitrary; the hopper, power connection and excavation each had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The practical assembly was satisfying, and I would be curious how the growing bay becomes usable despite its lack of breathable air.
